newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: M&R settles Siemens dispute - paper.
newsitem.headline: M&R settles Siemens dispute - paper.

text.p: South African construction and engineering firm, Murray & Roberts Ltd (M&R), had settled its dispute with German-based project manager Siemens over a 500 million rand Taiwanese train contract with M&R Union Carriage & Wagon, Business Day newspaper said.
M&R financial director Lionel Bird confirmed to the paper that settlement had been reached but he declined to give further details until the group's related insurance claims had been settled.

The dispute, which relates to the carriages supplied to Siemens failing stress tests, has weighed on M&R's earnings since last yar. The group announced in August that it had set aside a 160 million rand provision to deal.
It was unclear how much, if any, of the money would be recovered, the paper said.
M&R shares have beat a recovery path in the past week rising to a 13.35 rand close on Wednesday.
